Mara set the cup beside the register. Rain tapped the front window. She counted twelve dollars, locked the drawer, and carried the deposit book upstairs.

At noon, Daniel replaced the cracked hinge on the pantry door. He measured the gap twice, chose a shorter screw, and tested the latch with his thumb. The door closed without scraping.

I kept the receipt because the date mattered. The meeting began at nine, ended at ten fifteen, and produced two decisions: repair the south wall and postpone the roof work until October.
